newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Big potential for P&U's Detrusitol - Lehma.
newsitem.headline: Big potential for P&U's Detrusitol - Lehma.

text.p: Marketing opportunities for Pharmacia & Upjohn's Detrusitol, a treatment for incontinence, were good and sales could reach $500 million in the next five years, a report by Lehman Brothers said.
"We believe that Detrusitol will significantly expand the drug market for urinary incontinence (around 10 million people in the U.S. are believed to have the condition)," an analyst report said.
"By capturing even a small portion of this market, Detrusitol sales could reach several hundred million dollars.
"Our five year sales estimate is $500 million."

The Lehman report said sales of new P&U drugs would account for seven percent of company sales in 1996 although the company expected to lift this to 20 percent by 1999 due mainly to Detrusitol, glaucoma treatment Xalatan and Camptosar used for colon cancer.
P&U has just completed phase III for Detrusitol and the drug is expected to be filed with regulatory agencies in Europe and the U.S. early in 1997.
